chunks: And whatever is in it from ʿAmmār ibn Marwān al-Kalbī, I have narrated it from Muḥammad ibn Mūsā ibn al-Mutawakkil — may Allah be pleased with him — from ʿAbdullāh ibn Jaʿfar al-Ḥimyarī, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn ibn Abī al-Khaṭṭāb, from al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb, from Abū Ayyūb al-Khazzār, from ʿAmmār ibn Marwān.

key_terms.الْحِمْيَرِيِّ: A nisbah identifying ʿAbdullāh ibn Jaʿfar al-Ḥimyarī
key_terms.الْخَزَّارِ: A nisbah identifying Abū Ayyūb al-Khazzār
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I narrated it; a transmission formula indicating receipt and reporting
key_terms.عَمَّارِ بْنِ مَرْوَانَ الْكَلْبِيِّ: A transmitter whose narration-chain is being identified here

ai.seo_question: What is the sanad of Shaykh al-Ṣadūq to ʿAmmār ibn Marwān al-Kalbī in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage is a transmission-chain clarification from Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh, identifying the author’s sanad to ʿAmmār ibn Marwān al-Kalbī. Its significance lies in hadith documentation and source-tracing, showing how the narration reaches this transmitter through named intermediaries.
